descriptionFull: Hierarchical navigation trail that renders the path of pages leading to the current view. Each item can be a link (`href` or `onClick`) or plain text; the last item is rendered as the current page. Pass `showBack` to prepend a "back" affordance for mobile/touch layouts. The separator between items is customisable via `separator` (defaults to `/`)

props.name: items
props.description: Ordered trail; the last item is rendered as current

props.name: itemClassName
props.description: Class names applied to each item

props.name: backClassName
props.description: Class names applied to the back button

props.name: onBackClick
props.description: Callback fired when the back button is clicked

fields.name: href
fields.description: Renders the crumb as a link; takes precedence over `onClick`

fields.name: onClick
fields.description: Renders the crumb as a button when `href` is absent; with neither, the crumb is plain text
